content:
**Visual Analysis:**

- **Plant**: Sugarcane (long strap-like leaves)
- **Affected parts**: Multiple leaves — some fully tan/straw-colored (dead/dying), others showing a prominent yellow-to-tan longitudinal stripe along what appears to be the midrib
- **Pattern**: Yellowing starts at the midrib/central vein and spreads outward; older/lower leaves are fully yellowed while upper leaves show midrib yellowing on otherwise green blades
- **Other notes**: Some purple/reddish coloration near the stem base; no discrete spots, no mosaic/streaking patterns, no twisting or distortion of growing points

**Reasoning through classes:**

- **Brown_Spot**: Requires discrete brown oval spots with halos — not visible here
- **Grassy_Shoot**: Would show proliferation of many small thin shoots — not present
- **Pokkah_Boeng**: Would show twisted, distorted young leaves and necrotic growing points — not present
- **Sett_Rot**: Primarily affects seed setts/roots, not manifesting as foliar yellowing this way
- **Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv / Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus**: Would show alternating green/yellow mosaic or streak patterns — not present
- **Yellow_Spot**: Would show discrete yellow spots/lesions — not the pattern seen
- **Leaf_Scald**: Causes pencil-line white streaks and general scalding — possible but streaks not clearly defined here
- **Yellow_Leaf**: Classic symptom is midrib yellowing (yellowing starts at the central vein, progresses to whole leaf), older leaves affected first, progressing to complete straw-yellow senescence — **matches the image well**

The progression from midrib yellowing to complete leaf yellowing on lower/older leaves is the hallmark symptom. No discrete spots, mosaic patterns, or shoot distortion are visible."}
